description: Defines classes and structures for managing cell group configurations in a scheduler, including resource pools for cells and UEs, and configuration management functions.

classes.name: du_cell_config_pool
classes.description: Manages configuration pools for a single cell, including BWP configurations and UE resource pools.

classes.name: du_cell_group_config_pool
classes.description: Manages configurations for all cells and UEs within a cell group, providing methods to add and remove cells and UEs.

methods.name: du_cell_config_pool
methods.description: Constructor initializing cell configuration pool with scheduler config and request message.

methods.name: update_ue
methods.description: Updates UE configuration within the cell.

methods.name: add_bwp
methods.description: Adds BWP configuration to a UE.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new cell configuration.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell and its resources by index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates resources for a new UE.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures resources for an existing UE.
